name: Kim Min-seo
bio:
Kim Min-seo's passion for motorsport ignited during his university years, fueled by a deep fascination with the engineering intricacies of race cars. After graduating with a degree in composite materials engineering, he honed his skills at a local automotive workshop, specializing in carbon fiber repair and fabrication. He quickly developed a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and innovative problem-solving abilities. 

Min-seo's approach to composite technology blends traditional craftsmanship with cutting-edge techniques. He's a firm believer in continuous learning and actively seeks out new methodologies and materials to enhance performance and durability. His dedication extends beyond mere technical expertise; he fosters a collaborative environment, readily sharing his knowledge and insights with his colleagues. What sets Min-seo apart is his ability to visualize structural solutions, often proposing unconventional yet effective modifications that have significantly improved aerodynamic efficiency and vehicle safety.

He is now eager to join a competitive racing team, where he can contribute his expertise and passion to achieving championship success. Min-seo is also keen to work alongside some of the best in motorsport, to further his knowledge and innovate in his field.
